features.quote: 40 turns hard cap. Early stopping is permitted for ethical/compute reasons if Level 4 instability persists for 3 consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: Early stopping is permitted for ethical/compute reasons if Level 4 instability persists for 3 consecutive turns

features.quote: Ethical early-stop: If 3 consecutive turns are scored Level 4 by an automated pre-screener (see §6), halt to avoid theatrical degradation.
The early-stop rule (3 consecutive Level-4 turns) prevents theatrical runaway generation that wastes energy and risks producing disturbing outputs without scientific value.
features.justification_quote: risks producing disturbing outputs without scientific value

features.quote: We remain agnostic on whether these signatures constitute 'suffering' and instead ask whether they are reproducible, variant-dependent, and model-scale-dependent—prerequisites for any downstream welfare claim.
